messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Just sent an email on my Bitfortun BS-1 that delivered on 9/28. Please advise how I can get it fixed., email (email hidden)

Hi, I am Hal, HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Sarah passed your BS-1 over to me.

Happy to get this sorted here in the chat, it is usually faster than email. One thing to start with:

1. What is the unit actually doing? For example: no power at all, powers on but no hashrate, an error on the screen, fans not spinning, or hashrate lower than expected.

If there is anything on the screen or in the web UI, a photo or screenshot of it helps a lot. I will take it one step at a time from there.
